title: Dvc: pyasn1 has quadratic-complexity denial of service in binary REAL decoding (CVE-2026-119197)
description: pyasn1 versions up to 0.6.4 contain a denial of service vulnerability in the decoding of binary-encoded ASN.1 REAL values with large mantissas. The decoding process is quadratic in the mantissa length, causing excessive CPU consumption when processing attacker-controlled input. This affects BER, CER, and DER decoders using the RealPayloadDecoder. The vulnerability is fixed in pyasn1 version 0.6.5. Applications using vulnerable versions should upgrade or limit input containing REAL values.
